section_path: DEFINITION OF ANATOMIC SITES WITHIN THE HEAD AND NECK
text: All sites to which a Summary Stage chapter applies are listed at the beginning of the chapter.

section_path: DEFINITION OF ANATOMIC SITES WITHIN THE HEAD AND NECK
text: The oral cavity extends from the skin-vermilion junction of the lips to the junction of the hard and soft palate above and to the line of circumvallate papillae below.

section_path: DEFINITION OF ANATOMIC SITES WITHIN THE HEAD AND NECK
text: The nasopharynx begins anteriorly at the posterior choana and extends along the plane of the airway to the level of the free border of the soft palate. It includes the vault, floor (superior surface of soft palate), posterior wall, lateral walls including the fossae of Rosenmuller and the mucosa covering the torus tubarious forming the eustachian tube orifice.

section_path: DEFINITION OF ANATOMIC SITES WITHIN THE HEAD AND NECK
text: However, all subsites listed above (except nasal fossa) are included in the nasopharynx Summary Stage chapter.

section_path: DEFINITION OF ANATOMIC SITES WITHIN THE HEAD AND NECK
text: The hypopharynx is that portion of the pharynx extending from the plane of the superior border of the hyoid bone (or floor of the vallecula) to the plane corresponding to the lower border of the cricoid cartilage and includes the pyriform fossae, the lateral and posterior hypopharyngeal walls and the postcricoid region.
